description: Illustrative bandwidth-limited PAM4 simulation, not a calibrated optical-link simulation. Visual small-opening selection. Original retained random symbol sequence replayed explicitly; seed and additive noise unchanged. Constant endpoint guards are used for explicit replay.

model_settings.guard_policy: constant endpoint extension; no repetition or wraparound
model_settings.alignment: centered logistic kernel; ideal jumps on integer UI samples; causal channel delay retained
model_settings.model: offline logistic smoothing + optional causal first-order low-pass

eye_alignment: start_k = b_k - 0.5*T + display_phase_ui*T; nominal boundary at 0.5-phase UI

rendering.density_line_underlay: first 500 source traces; display only; not histogram counts

demonstration_selection.guard_note: Explicit replay holds endpoints; comparison excludes eight UIs at each end.
demonstration_selection.criterion: Visual demonstration only; no BER, EH/EW or compliance claim.
